summary: Nothing changed: the operator's site refuses, so no rate and no field could be confirmed. Lakefront supported on imagery; pin correction and rate evidence in flags.
flags: UNREAD: southarm.com answers 403 to plain requests (and its certificate doesn't cover the bare domain); the 10-16 pass got nothing either. I didn't work around it. So no operator rate, season or rig text.

GATE: no operator-posted rate available. RV Life 2026 reviewers paid $35 (motorhome, site A4, 8/2026) and $45 (fifth wheel, A3, 9/2026); 8/2025 $42. Tier $$ (avg 38). Rangeley directory undated '$15.00 - $32.00 per Night', '2 Night Minimum Stay'. Fees left empty, as camper rates count only where the operator has no web page and this one has. Gateway: none within 40 km. Presence: Google open, 97 reviews, phone 207-364-5155 matching stored.
RATINGS: Google 4.6 (97); RV Life 4.5 (9); The Dyrt 4.33 (count not read); Campendium no aggregate shown; Campspot not listed.
POSSIBLE MINIMUM: the directory's undated 2-night minimum isn't written; a 2-night minimum would be allowed anyway.

OPERATIONS: RV Life tip: 'Camp runs on generators, so no power or water between 9pm and 7am bath house included' and 'No Verizon service.' Not written to the note since no operator page confirms; say if you want it. CampLinq's copy lists 30-amp W/E, 65 sites, about 50% on the lake; aggregator, not used for electric.

WATERFRONT 'lakefront' stands: imagery shows the peninsula with sand along its west shore and openings right behind it; RV Life 9/2026: 'Beach is huge if you get one of the many beach sites!' Canopy hides most pads, and the note's 'about half' remains unconfirmed.
PIN: stored 44.74556,-70.83739 is the clearing at the gate, ~365 m ESE of the camp peninsula. Corrected ~44.7467,-70.8417 (peninsula, seen on imagery; pads under canopy).
ACCESS: remote ('closest town is about an hour away', RV Life); nothing read on road condition.
